name: MailVeri
summary: Bulk email verification with SMTP, catch-all and disposable checks, an API and an MCP server; pay-as-you-go credits that never expire.
best_for: marketers and developers who verify email lists in bursts and want to buy credits once instead of paying a monthly subscription
skip_if: you want verification built into your email platform with a monthly plan, you need an accuracy number someone independent has tested, or you want a product we have tested ourselves
honest_knock: The accuracy and savings figures come from MailVeri’s own pricing page and comparison tables. Credits are one-time purchases, so there is no plan for monthly cleaning. The page does not name refund terms.

pricing.notes: (read 2026-11-13 on mailveri.com/pricing, US dollars) MailVeri sells pay-as-you-go credit packs with no subscription, and the page says credits never expire. A new account gets 1,000 free credits. Packs cost $9 for 10,000 credits, $19 for 25,000, $39 for 50,000 (shown with a 20% bonus, 60,000 credits in total), $59 for 100,000, $119 for 250,000, $199 for 500,000, $299 for 1,000,000, $599 for 2,500,000 and $999 for 5,000,000. Above 5 million credits the page points to custom enterprise pricing. Every pack includes the same features: syntax, domain and SMTP checks, disposable, role-based, catch-all and full-inbox detection, file upload of up to 1 million rows, a REST API and MCP server, webhooks and a 7-status report. The page compares its prices with other verifiers, and those figures are the vendor’s own. We did not buy credits, so we do not know the tax added or the refund terms.
